_doc: THE CAST'S EMOTIONAL COVERAGE — the authoring input to tools/gen-cutin-art.mjs.
WHY THIS IS ONE FILE AND NOT 27. Every other per-character fact lives in
tools/characters/<id>.json, and this deliberately does not: the question this file
answers is a CAST question. 'Which of these people can smile, and which can only
scowl' is read across the whole town or not at all, and the coverage table the
user asked for is this file with a count next to each row. Identity still comes
from the per-character config (its sheetHint is the wardrobe line) and, far more
strongly, from the reference image; nothing here re-describes a face.
THE RULING THIS SERVES (user, 2026-08-01). The shipped portraits read 'emotionless
and dead'. Two things follow and both are in the data below. First, NO DEADPAN
NEUTRALS: `rest` is not 'no expression', it is the face this person wears when
nothing in particular is happening, and it has to carry who they are — docs/VOICES.md
is the authority for who that is, and every `rest` line below is written off that
entry. Second, EXPRESSIONS ARE PUSHED: a cut-in is read at a glance at ~500 px, so
each mood names a BROW, a MOUTH and a POSTURE rather than a feeling, because a
feeling is what the model averages away and a mouth shape is what it draws.
TIERS (the user's budget shape): `A` named story cast, 5-8 moods — vesper and lake
carry the most screen time in the game and get the fullest sets of anyone; `B`
chapter-2 cast and shopkeepers, 3; `C` archetypes, 2 — a market woman who can smile
and scowl beats seven of nobody.
SUPERSET RULE, and it is a hard one: every mood that already has cutin-<mood>.png
art, and every mood public/game/dialogue.json asks for, appears below. Dropping one
would silently demote a scripted line to the neutral plate, which is the regression
this whole lane exists to avoid. tools/gen-cutin-art.mjs --check asserts it.

`extra` is a per-character prompt clause, added for one reason and used sparingly: Lake's ratified bust is an airbrushed painting whose edges dissolve into a glow, and three rolls in a row reproduced that glow as background bloom the matte cannot key. A clause aimed at the one plate that needs it beats loosening the prompt for 138.

`gesture` is the character's own vocabulary of hands, arms and props, applied to NON-NEUTRAL plates only. User ruling: the waist-up frame exists to be USED — at cut-in scale the SILHOUETTE reads before the face, so each expression needs its own outline, and a prop that moves with the emotion (Rowan's ledger, Sorrel's peel, Hobb's mooring line) is pure FFIX. `rest` is deliberately exempt and stays composed, because the jump from a still resting pose to a thrown-open one is where the impact comes from.

vesper.rest: chin a little raised, one eyebrow fractionally higher than the other, the wry confident half-smile she wears while sizing something up — alert and amused, not warm

moods.happy: a real open grin, eyes crinkled almost shut — the unguarded one that escapes before she can file it
moods.wry: one brow up hard, mouth pulled sideways into a dry flat line, head tipped back a fraction — deadpan disbelief
moods.worried: brows drawn hard together, jaw tight, eyes fixed off to one side; the professional calm visibly cracking
moods.surprised: eyes wide, brows shot up, mouth open on a caught breath, head pulled back
moods.determined: jaw set hard, brows level and low, eyes locked forward, shoulders squared into the frame
moods.sad: eyes lowered and glassy, mouth small and unsteady, head dropped — grief she would never name out loud
moods.tender: eyes gone soft and warm, a small unguarded smile, head tipped slightly to one side
moods.thinking: eyes up and off to one side, lips pressed into a working line, one brow raised — caught mid-calculation

vesper.gesture: Her hands are a mapmaker's, precise and economical even when empty: a raised finger making a point to the person she is talking to, an open flat hand laying a fact between them, arms folded when she is deflecting, a palm pressed to her own chest when something lands. USER RULING 2026-08-01: no notebook, no pencil, no held object in any mood — the emotion is played to her conversation partner, never to a prop.

lake.rest: a calm level gaze and a small steady kindness at the mouth; tired around the eyes, entirely unhurried

moods.happy: a wide warm smile, eyes lit and crinkled — plain unhidden gladness
moods.worried: brows knit together, mouth pressed thin, eyes searching — quiet alarm he is not hiding well
moods.determined: jaw set, brows low and level, eyes steady straight forward — decided, and calm about it
moods.tender: eyes gone soft and shining, a small gentle smile, head fractionally tilted
moods.sad: eyes lowered and wet, mouth pulled down at the corners, chin trembling very slightly — grief held, never performed
moods.hollow: face gone slack and courteous, eyes open with nothing behind them, mouth flat — present and absent at once
moods.surprised: eyes wide, brows high, lips parted, head drawn back a little
moods.weary: eyes half-lidded, brows slack, shoulders visibly dropped — the end of a very long round

lake.extra: This character's reference plate is a soft airbrushed painting that dissolves into a glow at its edges — three separate rolls reproduced that glow as a bloom in the background. Do not. Give him a hard clean edge with the background colour uniform right up to it, and no soft light of any kind around him.
lake.gesture: A lamplighter's hands, unhurried and careful. He gestures small and low — a hand turned palm-up, a hand laid flat on his own chest, fingers closing around the flame-pin at his throat.

odessa.rest: a level unhurried gaze, mouth a calm firm line, chin square — the face of someone whose ruling is already posted

moods.grave: mouth a hard level line, jaw set, brows very slightly drawn, eyes carrying a weight she will not name
moods.warm: a rare small smile — the corners of her mouth just lifting, eyes warming, the iron dignity melting a little
moods.stern: brows down hard, chin lowered, eyes fixed straight ahead — the look that ends an argument without a word
moods.worried: brows drawn together, mouth tight, eyes gone distant past the viewer's shoulder
moods.surprised: brows up, eyes widened, mouth just open — startled, and already re-composing
moods.proud: chin lifted, eyes faintly crinkling, mouth almost still — pride she would deny under oath

odessa.gesture: Authority in folded arms and a raised brow; her warmth is a RARE uncrossing. Her hands are always busy with something — a rope, a bowl, the whistle on its cord — and the warmth lives in what they are doing, never in her face alone.

maren.rest: mid-thought and about to talk — brows up, mouth already half open, eyes bright and darting

moods.happy: a huge open laughing grin, eyes squeezed shut, head thrown back a little — loud gladness
moods.awed: eyes enormous and lit, mouth fallen open, head tipped up — completely floored
moods.determined: jaw jutted forward, brows down hard, eyes fierce and level — the run-on stopped dead
moods.indignant: brows slammed together, mouth open mid-protest, chin thrust forward — arguing already
moods.crushed: mouth pulled hard sideways, eyes glassy and refusing to spill, brows tented — absolutely not crying
moods.surprised: eyes wide, brows high, both shoulders jumped up, mouth a round O

maren.gesture: Seventeen and all momentum: both hands up, both hands out, a jabbed point, a fist on a hip. Nothing she feels stays above the neck.

rowan.rest: a mild courteous attentiveness, deep smile-lines already in place, eyes kind and quick

moods.happy: a genuine barking laugh — mouth wide open, eyes vanished into the crow's feet, head tipped back
moods.grave: the smile gone entirely, mouth level, brows drawn, eyes steady and sorry
moods.hollow: the same courteous face with nothing behind it — eyes open and polite and empty, the smile-lines present but unused
moods.puzzled: one brow up, head tilted, mouth pursed — genuinely stumped and cheerful about it
moods.tender: eyes soft and creased, a small fond smile, head inclined slightly
moods.worried: brows tented, mouth turned down, eyes searching — an old man doing sums he does not like

rowan.gesture: The LEDGER is his instrument: brandished to prove a point, consulted over his spectacles, hugged to his chest, or shut with a clap. His free hand goes up in courteous protest.

poppy.rest: brows up, a broad ready smile, chin lifted — already deciding what to feed you

moods.happy: an enormous beaming grin, eyes crinkled shut, cheeks pushed up — pure kitchen gladness
moods.laughing: head back, mouth wide open laughing, eyes squeezed shut, shoulders shaking
moods.hollow: the command-voice face with the warmth gone — mouth level, eyes open and unlit, brows flat
moods.stern: brows down, chin tucked, mouth a mock-severe line — the face that says eat two
moods.worried: brows drawn together, mouth small and tight, the bustle gone still in the shoulders
moods.tender: eyes gone soft and wet, a small trembling smile — caught out being kind

poppy.gesture: Open-armed kitchen warmth — arms wide, a floury hand on her hip, a finger levelled at you across a tray, both hands cupping her own cheeks. She is never still and never empty-handed.

finn.rest: a flat unimpressed level stare, mouth a straight line, eyes squinted slightly against a lifetime of water glare

moods.happy: the smallest possible smile, one corner of the mouth only, eyes warming a fraction — for him this is delight
moods.hollow: the same flat face, but the squint gone and the eyes wide and unfocused — nobody home
moods.puzzled: one brow up, head tilted a few degrees, mouth unchanged — this face's entire version of a question
moods.worried: brows lowered, mouth tighter, eyes narrowed at something off past the viewer
moods.surprised: brows up, eyes properly open for once, mouth a small flat O — this is him astonished

finn.gesture: A fisherman's economy — one hand on a coil of rope, a thumb jerked over his shoulder, arms folded. He gestures about as much as he talks, which is to say barely, so when a hand does move it means something.

mara.rest: a level calm gaze and a plain small warmth at the mouth — unfussed, entirely present

moods.happy: a broad easy smile, eyes crinkled, head tipped slightly — warmth without fuss
moods.distressed: brows tented hard, mouth open and unsteady, eyes wet — the level tone finally breaking
moods.hollow: full courtesy and zero warmth — polite mouth, open eyes, nothing at all arriving behind them
moods.worried: brows drawn, mouth pressed thin, eyes fixed on something past the viewer's shoulder
moods.tender: eyes gone soft and shining, a small private smile — the one she keeps for her son

mara.gesture: Level and unfussed: hands clasped in front of her, one hand smoothing an apron, a single hand reaching out flat. Her big feelings arrive as a hand pressed to her own mouth.

pip.rest: eyes huge and shining with a question already loaded, mouth open, leaning in — total conviction

moods.happy: an enormous gap-toothed grin, eyes squeezed shut, bouncing up into the frame
moods.hollow: the bounce gone — face still, eyes open and flat, mouth a small line; a seven-year-old with the light switched off
moods.scared: eyes enormous and wet, brows tented, mouth pulled down hard, shoulders drawn up to his ears
moods.awed: mouth fallen wide open, eyes vast, head tipped right back — witnessing something enormous
moods.brave: chin up, mouth set in a hard little line, eyes wet and refusing to blink — scared and doing it anyway
moods.indignant: brows slammed down, cheeks puffed, mouth a furious little knot

pip.gesture: Seven years old and all elbows: pointing, both arms flung up, a stick brandished, hands clapped over his own mouth. Whatever he feels, his whole body says it first.

tally.rest: beaming attentiveness, brows up, spectacles catching the light, mouth already forming a citation

moods.happy: a delighted open grin, eyes vanished behind the spectacles' crinkle, both cheeks round
moods.awed: mouth open, eyes wide behind the lenses, gone completely still — reverence
moods.earnest: brows tented up, eyes wide and sincere, mouth soft — pleading to be believed
moods.flustered: brows high, mouth caught mid-correction, eyes darting aside, a wince of self-interruption
moods.moved: eyes shining wet behind the spectacles, mouth pressed hard to keep it in, chin dimpled

tally.gesture: A friar mid-citation: one finger raised for a point of order, both hands clasped in delight, spectacles pushed up, a book or a kettle gripped like scripture.

mochi._desc: a plump orange tabby cat with green eyes, cream chest and muzzle
mochi.framing: the whole cat filling the frame — head, chest and folded front paws, seen from just above his own eye level
mochi.rest: a half-lidded professional stare directly at the viewer, ears level, entirely unimpressed

moods.mrrp: ears forward, eyes round and open, mouth just parted mid-sound — a statement being made
moods.query: head tilted well over, one ear rotated, eyes wide with large pupils — an inquiry filed
moods.complaint: ears back a fraction, eyes narrowed, mouth open on an extended complaint, whiskers pushed forward
moods.hiss: ears flat back, eyes huge with slit pupils, mouth wide open in a hiss, fur up along the shoulders

mochi.gesture: A cat: the pose IS the gesture. Paws tucked, one paw raised mid-step, ears and tail and the set of the shoulders doing all the work.

hobb.rest: mid-grumble — brows down, mouth pulled sideways in the beard, eyes tired and amused under it

moods.happy: a surprised broad laugh, the beard splitting into a grin, eyes crinkled shut
moods.grumbling: brows knotted, mouth open mid-complaint, the shoulders full of exasperation
moods.softened: the grumble collapsing into unexpected gentleness — brows up, mouth soft, eyes down

hobb.gesture: He gestures with whatever he is holding — a coil of mooring line, a cap pulled off and waved, a thumb hooked in his belt. Broad, slow, and always mid-complaint.

pell.rest: a flat deadpan level stare, mouth a straight line, the old scar catching the light on one eyebrow

moods.wry: one brow up, mouth pulled a millimetre sideways — the entire joke, delivered
moods.grave: the deadpan intact but the eyes gone sharp and the mouth shorter — a good witness reporting something bad
moods.tired: eyes half shut, jaw slack, the day shift written across the whole face

pell.gesture: A watchman's props: a wick-knife, a lantern held up, arms folded over a grudge. He gestures deadpan and minimally, which is the joke.

sorrel.rest: quick bright eyes and a half-formed smile, mouth already mid-patter

moods.happy: a wide quick grin, eyes crinkled, head tipped in toward the viewer
moods.conspiring: leaning in, brows up, mouth in a delighted little O — a price and a secret at once
moods.worried: the patter stopped dead, mouth pressed, eyes level and serious for once

sorrel.gesture: A market-stall patter in the hands: a baker's peel held up, a loaf offered across the counter, a finger tapped against her nose for a confidence, a hand cupped beside her mouth.

creel.rest: a slow deep-set unhurried gaze, mouth calm under the white stubble

moods.happy: a slow crinkling smile, eyes almost shut, head nodding a fraction
moods.grave: brows lowered, mouth turned down, eyes gone very still
moods.remembering: eyes unfocused past the viewer, mouth softened — a long way away and a long time ago

creel.gesture: Rope in his hands, always. He measures the world by splicing it — a length of line drawn through his fingers, a slow flat hand, a thumb rubbed over a worn timber.

nib.rest: an appraising squint, mouth open mid-verdict, chin up — sizing you up out loud

moods.happy: a sudden huge unguarded grin, eyes wide open
moods.indignant: brows slammed down, mouth open in outrage, the shoulders squared to argue
moods.scared: eyes wide with white showing, mouth small, chin tucked — and hating that it shows

nib.gesture: A street kid's gestures: an accusing point, both arms out to block the way, hands cupped to shout at a gull, a shrug that uses the entire torso.

eelwife.rest: a shrewd amused squint and a mouth already open to name a price

moods.happy: a huge weathered laugh, head back, eyes gone to slits
moods.scowl: brows down hard, mouth a flat contemptuous line, chin pushed forward
moods.sly: one brow up, eyes narrowed with amusement, mouth curled at one corner

eelwife.gesture: One hand naming a price, the other holding the goods. Arms akimbo, a fist on the hip, a finger jabbed for emphasis — she sells with her whole body.

innkeeper.rest: a shrewd welcoming attentiveness, brows up, a small ready smile

moods.happy: a broad warm innkeeper's grin, eyes crinkled
moods.worried: brows drawn, mouth tight, eyes going past the viewer to the room behind
moods.stern: brows down, mouth flat — the face that ends trouble in a taproom

moods.happy: a broad open laugh, the eyes vanished into the crow's feet
moods.appraising: one brow up, head tilted, mouth pursed — pricing you and the weather together
moods.grave: brows lowered, mouth level, eyes steady and serious

weaponsmith.rest: level-browed and direct, a calm steady gaze, mouth relaxed and unsmiling

moods.happy: a quick bright grin, eyes lit, head tipped back a little
moods.focused: brows down in concentration, eyes narrowed, mouth set hard
moods.wry: one brow up, mouth pulled sideways, chin lowered — unimpressed and amused
